title: What it must be able to do
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: the utility's capabilities, what it must be able to do whoever does it, in three levels, each with an owner, heat-mapped to show where it hurts and where the money goes.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Amber is the strategy layer, where capabilities live. Green, amber and red say how well a capability works today. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
